description: This file contains Django REST Framework serializers for user registration, login, and note management, including validation logic and model serialization.

classes.name: RegisterSerializer
classes.description: Serializer to register a new user with username, email (optional) and password.

classes.name: LoginSerializer
classes.description: Serializer to authenticate user and return token-like response for session auth.

methods.name: validate_username
methods.description: Validates that the username is not already taken.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new user with a hashed password.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates user credentials and account status during login.

methods.name: validate_title
methods.description: Validates that the note title is not empty.
